harnessCard.question: Can a weak local worker emit a bounded, structurally valid ActionPlan through LM Studio response_format json_schema often enough to justify an opt-in production path?
harnessCard.scoring: One point only when JSON parses, the ActionPlan validates, every requested capability is represented, every tool is allowed, and the dependency graph is ordered and bounded.
harnessCard.fleetPolicy: The controller admitted the already-loaded model under the one-resident m4mini cap and retained the safe warm fleet after the run.

productionDecision.boundary: Only manifest-backed worker tools are visible to the plan producer. The internal executor dispatches the already policy- and broker-wrapped tool implementations and invokes the existing approval callback for each step.
productionDecision.recovery: A failed step returns a compact typed failure to the normal SDK loop. Successful mutation tool+argument fingerprints are checkpointed in the session so replanning cannot replay completed side effects; reads always run again so later plans observe fresh workspace state.
productionDecision.planningSessions: Decomposition seeds always fall back to normal agent mode because their trusted control-plane tools intentionally are not worker ActionPlan tools.
